notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Stuffy Doll if it has summoning sickness.
description:
Deal damage to Stuffy Doll, either using its ability or another method.
Stuffy Doll triggers, attempting to deal damage to you, but dealing damage to Stuffy Doll instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.
